description: A shell script containing tests for Git fetch negotiation, including configuration validation, commit skipping logic, ref advertisement filtering, clock skew handling, and ACK processing.

methods.name: have_sent
methods.description: Checks if specific commits have been sent in the trace output.

methods.name: have_not_sent
methods.description: Checks if specific commits have not been sent in the trace output.

methods.name: trace_fetch
methods.description: Performs a git fetch with tracing enabled, disabling GIT_TRACE_PACKET in the child process.
